# STTORIA

> STTORIA (Fotografía & Video) is a wedding photography and video studio in Guayaquil, Ecuador. Its focus is weddings, covered in photo and video with a printed album. It also offers Save the Date sessions, personalized photo sessions outdoors or indoors, and birthday and celebration coverage. The website is in Spanish.

## Services

- Bodas (weddings): full-day photo and video coverage, from the morning preparations to the last dance, with a printed album.
- Save the Date: a pre-wedding session to announce the date and get comfortable in front of the camera.
- Sesiones personalizadas: portraits, couples and family sessions, outdoors or indoors.
- Cumpleaños y celebraciones: birthdays and intimate celebrations.

## Pages

- [Home](https://sttoria.studio/): about the studio, services and portfolio
